body_lead: Pramesh S Jain Karnataka is positioning itself as a national leader in AI-driven urban water governance,with artificial intelligence and digital technologies set to play a central role in managing future challenges such as climate change,rapid urbanisation,groundwater depletion,and infrastructure stress,Chief Secretary Dr.Shalini Rajneesh said on Tuesday. She was speaking at the inaugural session of the National AI & Digital Water Summit 2026,organised by the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) in association with elets and KPMG at Bengaluru.
